verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented first-party feature for exporting all account data (workflows, connected accounts, event history, key/value data) in open formats. The REST API, the CLI's historical-event retrieval and source-available components are building blocks a user could assemble into an export, and the community note about rebuilding elsewhere describes a user-side migration workaround; neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
